EmpiricalPredicate.role: typed boolean predicate over respondent-bound empirical incidence

canonicalization.AND_OR: flatten same operator; canonicalize children; sort children by child semantic hash; exact duplicate children collapse idempotently
canonicalization.NOT: exactly one child; double-negation simplification is permitted only as canonical boolean identity normalization

EmpiricalQuerySpec.role: exact governed request for one empirical target distribution under one condition, risk set, source scope and measure basis

UNARY_DISTRIBUTION.condition: TRUE or an exact governed predicate

ARBITRARY_COORDINATE_CONJUNCTION.condition: AND/OR/NOT composition over exact empirical-coordinate leaves

BRANCH_COHORT_CONDITIONAL.condition: DERIVED_BRANCH_COHORT predicate optionally intersected with other exact predicates

same_respondent_law.rule: All condition leaves and target response components declared same-respondent are evaluated against one scoped respondent identity inside one exact empirical universe unless a separately governed exact cross-universe linkage/composition authority explicitly supplies a different lawful relation.
forbidden: multiply independent marginals to synthesize a conjunction
infer respondent cotravel from equal aggregate percentages
infer overlap from matching respondent identifier strings across universes
replace a missing joint with pairwise or unary approximations

modes.SOURCE_INDEXED_MULTI_UNIVERSE: exact finite set of distinct universes evaluated separately; outputs remain source-indexed
modes.AUTHORIZED_COMPOSITE: requires exact separately owned linkage/pooling/composition/nonduplication/estimand/weight authority sufficient for the requested composite measure

evaluation_semantics.respondent_domain: exact respondent members of source scope after source relation law
evaluation_semantics.risk_membership: R(r) is evaluated independently of C(r)
evaluation_semantics.condition_membership: C(r) is evaluated at respondent/event grain under exact predicate semantics
evaluation_semantics.target_evaluation: T(r) yields one exact scalar or topology-aware k-way target configuration
evaluation_semantics.raw_numerator: count of scoped respondents satisfying R and C and the exact target cell
evaluation_semantics.raw_denominator: count of scoped respondents satisfying R and C
evaluation_semantics.weighted_numerator: governed measure mass over the same exact numerator member set
evaluation_semantics.weighted_denominator: governed measure mass over the same exact denominator member set
evaluation_semantics.probability_or_share: derived from numerator/denominator only when denominator is positive and the selected measure is valid
evaluation_semantics.complete_fact: full governed target cell topology plus support/measure/typed-state/provenance; not a selected modal cell

XOR.required: represent via exact AND/OR/NOT predicate over same-respondent incidence or full joint target
XOR.forbidden: derive from unary association ranking or marginal products

K_WAY_PARITY.required: retain exact k-way respondent incidence/configuration topology
K_WAY_PARITY.forbidden: infer from all unary or pairwise marginals

SIMPSON_REVERSAL.required: represent pooled and exact stratifier-conditioned queries as distinct query identities with their own denominators and source/measure basis
SIMPSON_REVERSAL.comparison_role: derived diagnostic over exact facts; reversal itself is not a replacement primary fact

SAME_MARGINALS_DIFFERENT_JOINT.required: distinct EmpiricalFact content because full joint cells differ

diagnostic_boundary.primary_fact: complete E1/E2-style exact empirical distribution/joint incidence fact
diagnostic_boundary.diagnostic_receipt_requirement: must dereference exact source EmpiricalFact IDs and metric formula/version/measure authority
